purpose: Survey archives broadly but persist locally only records that exhibit explicit, structural, temporal, tag-level, query-level, or sufficiently strong semantic relationships to the current TOPA web. Newly pulled records become the next frontier.

topic_policy.query_role: Optional initial steering signal only; the crawler may discover unrelated but connected clusters through graph expansion.

archive_flow.stage_1_survey: Archive Gateway enumerates broad official metadata into ephemeral work storage.
archive_flow.stage_2_relation_test: SPIDER scores each survey candidate against the current local web using explicit source links, shared tags, shared dates, semantic similarity and optional query overlap.
archive_flow.stage_3_pull: Only connected candidates cross into local raw/unexamined persistence.
archive_flow.stage_4_frontier: Pulled records become new seeds for the next bounded round.
archive_flow.stage_5_weave: The union of prior web plus pulled records is re-woven into a dynamic graph.
archive_flow.stage_6_review: Edges remain discovery routes until independent evidence or explicit provenance supports stronger status.

dynamic_graph.keyword_nodes: Derived dynamically from TF-IDF-salient terms in the current corpus.
dynamic_graph.tag_nodes: Derived from provider metadata and record relation_tags.
dynamic_graph.source_lineage_edges: High-confidence provenance relation but independence_count remains zero for same-source lineage.

storage.ephemeral_archive_inventory: work/ or CI artifact; not committed as raw knowledge by default
storage.large_binaries: pointer/hash only unless explicitly bounded and justified
